title: diosphaera dubia
intro: Diosphaera dubia, commonly known as the "false earth star," is a type of plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Diosphaera dubia include its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit anti-cancer activities.
